fixes.cause: The importer wrote absolute source/target paths into distributable candidate receipts.
fixes.behavior: Stored receipts now use portable references; the local caller result retains its private paths, hashes and evidence.

fixes.cause: Windows O_APPEND handles reject ftruncate during bounded rotation.
fixes.behavior: Windows uses a writable handle with explicit positions and fresh EOF; POSIX keeps O_APPEND. Exact newest bytes, reopen, generation/cursor and sequential multi-handle writes were verified.

spreadsheet.tested: Create formulas, recalculate after input edit, export XLSX and reimport, preserve numeric/formula/UTF-8, render and visually inspect.

pdf.tested: Create interactive form, update canonical field value, reopen, compare widget effective value and appearance stream, render with Poppler and visually inspect.

remaining.action: No login, host URL, DNS configuration or credential changed.

remaining.detail: Controller not launched; existing Windows host-session workflow preserved.
